newsitem.title: USA: El Paso to restart gas pipeline Thursday.
newsitem.headline: El Paso to restart gas pipeline Thursday.

text.p: El Paso Natural Gas Co said it expects one of two failed natural gas pipelines north of Roswell, N.M. to return to service on the morning of Thursday, September 12.
The restored pipeline should bring about 480 million cubic feet (mmcf) per day of capacity back into service of the 550 mmcf of capacity that was taken out by damage on Tuesday.
The status of a second pipeline damaged in the incident was still being evaluated, El Paso said in a statement.
A 30-inch diameter El Paso pipeline failed about 30 miles north of Roswell on Tuesday afternoon, in an area where two pipelines run parallel, the company said..
Some Adjacent non El Paso gas gathering facilities were damaged and one employee of the McKay Oil Corp was hurt in the incident, El Paso said.
The extent of the employee's injuries was not known, the company said in the statement.
El Paso Natural Gas is the gas transmission subsidiary of El Paso Energy Corp.
